name: application-steps
title: Steps
description: Step indicator components that show a user's position within a multi-step process, supporting numbered, icon, and progress-bar styles for onboarding flows and multi-page forms.
useWhen: Guiding users through a multi-step form, checkout, or onboarding flow where showing progress reduces abandonment.
A process has three or more distinct sequential phases that the user cannot skip.
Users need orientation — knowing which step they are on and how many remain reduces uncertainty.
avoidWhen: The process has only one or two steps — a simple heading or subtitle is sufficient.
Steps can be completed in any order — a checklist or task list communicates non-linear progress better.
The form fits on a single page without overwhelming the user — pagination adds unnecessary friction.
responsiveBehavior: Horizontal step indicators compress to a progress-bar-only or step-count summary on small screens to avoid horizontal overflow. Vertical and timeline variants remain readable at all widths.
accessibility: Wrap the step list in a <nav> or <ol> element so screen readers announce it as an ordered list of steps.
Mark the current step with aria-current='step' on the active item.
Do not rely on color alone to distinguish completed, current, and upcoming steps — use icons or text labels alongside color.

variants.title: Title, icon and progress bar
variants.description: Horizontal step row showing a step icon, step title, and a progress bar beneath to communicate overall completion percentage.
accessibility: Progress bar should use a native <progress> element or role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, and aria-valuemax.

variants.title: Title, icon and progress bar (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-and-progress-bar step indicator adapted for dark application surfaces such as dark-mode onboarding flows.
accessibility: Step icon, title, and progress bar colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, step/total and progress bar
variants.description: Step header showing a 'Step X of Y' text counter alongside a title and a progress bar — ideal when icon-free brevity is preferred.
accessibility: The step counter text (e.g., 'Step 2 of 5') provides a text alternative for the progress bar's numeric value.

variants.title: Title, step/total and progress bar (Dark)
variants.description: Step-counter-and-progress-bar header adapted for dark surfaces, keeping the 'X of Y' readout visible without icons.
accessibility: Counter text and progress bar track colors must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Title, check icon and progress bar
variants.description: Step indicator that replaces numeric or category icons with a check icon for completed steps, reinforcing completion visually.
accessibility: Check icons for completed steps should carry aria-label='Completed' or equivalent so screen readers announce the state.

variants.title: Title, check icon and progress bar (Dark)
variants.description: Check-icon step indicator adapted for dark surfaces, retaining completion-state clarity against dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Check icon stroke and fill colors must meet contrast requirements against dark card backgrounds.

variants.title: Grouped with title and description, with highlighted current step
variants.description: Full step list showing all steps simultaneously with titles, short descriptions, and a highlighted active step — best for multi-step settings or onboarding wizards where context matters.
accessibility: Active step uses aria-current='step'; completed steps should be distinguishable via icon or text, not color alone.

variants.title: Grouped with title and description, with highlighted current step (Dark)
variants.description: Full grouped step list with descriptions adapted for dark application shells, with the active step visually distinguished.
accessibility: Active step highlight and description text must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.

variants.title: Timeline with title, with highlighted current step
variants.description: Vertical timeline-style step indicator showing all steps in a vertical list with a connecting line, suitable for taller layouts or side panels.
accessibility: Use an <ol> for the step list; the connecting line is decorative and should be hidden from assistive technology.

variants.title: Timeline with title, with highlighted current step (Dark)
variants.description: Vertical timeline step indicator adapted for dark surfaces, with the connector line and step markers visible against dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Connector line color and step dot borders must meet contrast requirements on dark card or panel backgrounds.
